diagnosis: The staging test fixture reseeding endpoint accepts targetOrgId in the URL and wipes and reseeds the tenant's staging dataset without confirming that the caller owns or is assigned to targetOrgId. A tester or automated runner from one organization can disrupt, delete, and overwrite active demo environments, pre-release UAT data, and test configurations of other corporate staging accounts.
